data.paraphrase: For any curve defined by the equation x³ + 3xy + y³ = 1, the equilateral sets on that curve have the property that they consist of exactly three points, and all pairwise distances between these points are equal. Furthermore, there exists a unique such equilateral set on the curve, and there exists another equilateral set whose area, as measured by the Lebesgue measure of its convex hull, is equal to the value putnam_2006_b1_solution.
